notes: status: 'yes' = controlled by one or more private equity firms; 'no' = verified not PE-controlled (public and widely held, founder/family owned, nonprofit, or a subsidiary of a non-PE parent). Absent domains resolve to 'unknown'. Every 'yes' entry was checked against the linked primary source on the verifiedOn date. 'no' entries for large, widely-held public companies carry no source link because their listing status is the evidence. Ownership changes constantly — re-verify before relying on an entry.

duckhorn.com.note: $1.95bn take-private of the Napa wine group closed December 2024.

tedbaker.com.note: Authentic Brands Group bought Ted Baker in 2022; the UK stores closed in 2024 and the brand is now licensed.

realmadrid.com.note: A members’ club owned by its socios.

circlek.com.note: Part of publicly listed Alimentation Couche-Tard.

loves.com.note: Privately held by the founding Love family.

cineworld.co.uk.note: The 2023 Chapter 11 wiped out shareholders and handed the group to its lenders.

picturehouses.com.note: Owned by Cineworld, which its lenders took over in 2023.

poundstretcher.co.uk.note: Fortress bought the discount chain in April 2024.

espressohouse.com.note: Nordic coffee chain held by the Reimann family’s JAB.

uswitch.com.note: Part of Houseful (formerly ZPG), alongside Zoopla.

gatwickairport.com.note: Controlled by VINCI Airports with 50.01%; the rest belongs to Global Infrastructure Partners, now part of BlackRock.

manchesterairport.co.uk.note: Owned by Manchester Airports Group — ten local councils and IFM Investors, an Australian pension-fund manager.

eurostar.com.note: Majority-owned by France’s state railway SNCF.

lner.co.uk.note: Publicly owned and run by the UK Department for Transport.

nationalexpress.com.note: Part of publicly listed Mobico Group.

shutterstock.com.note: Publicly listed; founder Jon Oringer is the largest holder.

moneysupermarket.com.note: Part of publicly listed MONY Group.

odeon.co.uk.note: Owned by publicly listed AMC Entertainment.

bluenile.com.note: Owned by publicly listed Signet Jewelers.

arhaus.com.note: Publicly listed; the founding Reed family holds voting control.

havertys.com.note: Publicly listed; Haverty family voting control.

tempurpedic.com.note: Part of publicly listed Somnigroup International, formerly Tempur Sealy.

nowfoods.com.note: Privately held by the founding Richard family.

naturemade.com.note: Owned by Pharmavite, a subsidiary of Otsuka of Japan.

familysearch.org.note: A non-profit run by the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints; free to use.

chicco.com.note: Part of Artsana, privately held by the Catelli family.

gracobaby.com.note: Part of publicly listed Newell Brands.

melissaanddoug.com.note: Owned by publicly listed Spin Master.

surgerypartners.com.note: Bain Capital holds about 39%, but the board rejected its buyout offer in 2025 and the company stays independent and publicly traded.

lifestance.com.note: TPG reported 29.3% in a 13G/A and has been selling down; it is the largest holder but does not control the company.

flyfrontier.com.note: Indigo Partners distributed most of its holding to its own investors in 2024. Chairman Bill Franke, who founded Indigo, remains the largest individual holder at close to 30%.
